visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An anthropomorphic Bulldog wearing a white bucket hat, a white tank top, and green athletic shorts leans over a large wooden cylindrical mortar placed on a wooden deck. He is actively kneading a massive ball of white, pillowy dough. Beside him, a Corgi in a white T-shirt and black shorts stands upright, gripping a long-handled wooden mallet with its paws. The setting is a traditional Japanese wooden house with sliding doors and a paper lantern visible under the eaves, illuminated by bright, even daylight. (2) The perspective shifts to a medium-full shot near a darker, stone-like mortar. The Corgi raises the large wooden mallet high above its head, preparing to strike. The Bulldog is positioned with its head nearly inside the mortar. The background shows a continuation of the traditional architectural style with a manicured garden and a wooden fence under a clear sky. (3) The Corgi swings the mallet downward with significant force. Instead of hitting the dough, the mallet strikes the Bulldog directly on its hat-covered head. A white, multi-pointed cartoon impact graphic appears momentarily at the point of contact. The Bulldog's upper body collapses onto the dough. A ring of animated yellow stars begins to rotate quickly above the Bulldog's hat, signifying dizziness, while the Corgi maintains a wide-eyed, shocked expression. (4) The scene returns to the original wooden porch setting. The Bulldog slowly lifts its head, appearing dazed and frustrated, looking directly at the Corgi. The Corgi holds the mallet vertically, its mouth open in a worried or apologetic expression. The lighting remains bright and natural, highlighting the textures of the fur and the wooden grain of the deck. (5) The camera cuts to a wide, expansive view of a traditional Japanese Zen garden with meticulously raked grey gravel and a wooden bridge. The Corgi is seen running at high speed away from the camera, its small legs moving rapidly. The Bulldog, still wearing its hat and tank top, is in mid-sprint, chasing the Corgi across the gravel path. The camera pans smoothly to follow the horizontal movement of the chase through the scenic courtyard.
